mentions.name: Compute Prices
mentions.description: A website that tracks and provides information on compute prices and usage. It collects pricing and usage data for compute resources, aiming to give people a sense of how compute costs evolve as compute becomes a critical resource alongside energy.
mentions.problem: Compute and energy are becoming two of the most important resources to track and manage, but there is little visibility into compute prices and usage.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://computeprices.com

A side project I started at the end of last year.

It's pretty clear that compute and energy are going to be two of the most important resources to track and manage in the coming decades. I'm trying to get a sense for prices and usage of compute and this project is my attempt to do that hopefully providing useful info to others as well.
